    <style>
        @import url('');
        
         {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            boxsizing: borderbox;
        }

        :root {
            bgprimary: FFF0F5;
            bgsecondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            bgtertiary: rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9);
            textprimary: 2D1B2E;
            textsecondary: 8B4789;
            texttertiary: C688C3;
            accentpink: FF1493;
            accentgold: FFD700;
            accentlightpink: FF85C1;
            accentglow: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.5);
            border: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        body {
            fontfamily: 'Poppins', applesystem, BlinkMacSystemFont, sansserif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, FFF0F5 0%, FFE4F0 50%, FFCFE5 100%);
            color: var(textprimary);
            overflowx: hidden;
            webkitfontsmoothing: antialiased;
            mozosxfontsmoothing: grayscale;
            position: relative;
        }

        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            backgroundimage: 
                radialgradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radialgradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radialgradient(circle at 40% 20%, rgba(255, 133, 193, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointerevents: none;
            zindex: 0;
        }
        
        .hero {
            minheight: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        herobackground {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            zindex: 0;
        }

        .herocontent {
            textalign: center;
            zindex: 1;
            maxwidth: 800px;
            padding: 0 20px;
            animation: fadeIn 1s easeout;
        }

        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(10px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .logo {
            fontsize: 72px;
            fontweight: 800;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            letterspacing: 2px;
            marginbottom: 16px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            textshadow: 0 0 30px var(accentglow);
            filter: dropshadow(0 4px 8px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3));
        }

        .tagline {
            fontsize: 24px;
            fontweight: 600;
            color: var(accentpink);
            marginbottom: 16px;
            lineheight: 1.4;
            textshadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .subtitle {
            fontsize: 16px;
            fontweight: 400;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            marginbottom: 48px;
            lineheight: 1.6;
            maxwidth: 550px;
            marginleft: auto;
            marginright: auto;
        }

        .ctabutton {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentlightpink) 100%);
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid var(accentgold);
            padding: 14px 36px;
            fontsize: 16px;
            fontweight: 700;
            borderradius: 980px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubicbezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            boxshadow: 0 6px 25px var(accentglow), 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            texttransform: uppercase;
            letterspacing: 1px;
        }
        
        .ctabutton:hover {
            transform: translateY(3px) scale(1.08);
            boxshadow: 0 10px 35px var(accentglow), 0 0 40px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5);
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentlightpink) 0%, var(accentpink) 100%);
        }

        .appcontainer {
            display: none;
            minheight: 100vh;
            flexdirection: column;
        }

        .appheader {
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            backdropfilter: blur(20px);
            webkitbackdropfilter: blur(20px);
            borderbottom: 2px solid var(border);
            padding: 12px 24px;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: spacebetween;
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            zindex: 100;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.1);
        }

        .applogo {
            fontsize: 24px;
            fontweight: 800;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
            letterspacing: 1px;
        }

        .modetoggle {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%);
            padding: 4px;
            borderradius: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            boxshadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15);
        }

        .modebtn {
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            fontsize: 13px;
            fontweight: 600;
            borderradius: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modebtn.active {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentlightpink) 100%);
            color: white;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 12px var(accentglow);
        }

        .maincontent {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            maxwidth: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 20px;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .chatarea,
        .sidebar {
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            backdropfilter: blur(30px);
            webkitbackdropfilter: blur(30px);
            borderradius: 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            boxshadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.15);
        }

        .chatarea {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .messages {
            flex: 1;
            overflowy: auto;
            padding: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .message {
            maxwidth: 85%;
            animation: slideIn 0.4s cubicbezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(15px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .message.user {
            alignself: flexend;
        }

        .messagecontent {
            padding: 14px 18px;
            borderradius: 18px;
            lineheight: 1.6;
            fontsize: 14px;
            color: var(textprimary);
        }

        .message.user .messagecontent {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentlightpink) 100%);
            color: white;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px var(accentglow);
            border: 1px solid var(accentgold);
        }

        .message.assistant .messagecontent {
            background: var(bgtertiary);
            border: 1px solid var(border);
        }

        .messagemeta {
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            gap: 8px;
            marginbottom: 6px;
            fontsize: 12px;
            color: var(texttertiary);
        }

        .inputarea {
            padding: 14px;
            bordertop: 2px solid var(border);
            background: lineargradient(to top, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.5) 0%, transparent 100%);
        }

        .inputwrapper {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            alignitems: flexend;
        }

        .messageinput {
            flex: 1;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 100%);

            fontsize: 14px;

        .messageinput:focus {
            outline: none;
            bordercolor: var(accentpink);
            boxshadow: 0 0 0 4px var(accentglow);
        }

        .sendbtn {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentlightpink) 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(accentgold);

            justifycontent: center;

            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px var(accentglow);

        .sendbtn:hover {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentlightpink) 0%, var(accentpink) 100%);

            opacity: 0.5;

        .sendbtn svg {
            transition: transform 0.2s easeinout;
        }

        .sendbtn:hover svg {
            transform: translateY(2px);
        }

        .sidebar {
            width: 280px;
            padding: 20px;
            display: flex;
            flexdirection: column;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .sidebarsection h3 {
            fontsize: 12px;
            fontweight: 700;
            color: var(accentpink);
            marginbottom: 10px;
            texttransform: uppercase;
            letterspacing: 1px;
        }

        .statcard {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 100%);
            padding: 14px;
            borderradius: 14px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.1);
        }

        .statvalue {
            fontsize: 28px;
            fontweight: 800;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);

            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;

        .statlabel {
            fontsize: 11px;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            fontweight: 600;
        }

        .sourceitem {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.8) 100%);
            padding: 12px;
            borderradius: 12px;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            marginbottom: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .sourceitem:hover {
            bordercolor: var(accentpink);
            transform: translateX(4px);
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%);
            boxshadow: 0 4px 15px var(accentglow);
        }

        .sourcetitle {
            fontsize: 13px;
            fontweight: 600;
            marginbottom: 4px;
            color: var(textprimary);
        }

        .sourceurl {
            fontsize: 11px;
            color: var(texttertiary);
            textdecoration: none;
            display: block;
            overflow: hidden;
            textoverflow: ellipsis;
            whitespace: nowrap;
        }

        .loading {
            display: inlineflex;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .loading span {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);
            borderradius: 50%;
            animation: bounce 1.4s infinite easeinout both;
            boxshadow: 0 0 10px var(accentglow);
        }

        .loading span:nthchild(1) {
            animationdelay: 0.32s;
        }

        .loading span:nthchild(2) {
            animationdelay: 0.16s;
        }

        @keyframes bounce {
            0%, 80%, 100% {
                transform: scale(0);
            }
            40% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        .researchwidgetinteractive {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.95) 100%);
            backdropfilter: blur(20px);
            webkitbackdropfilter: blur(20px);
            border: 2px solid var(accentgold);
            borderradius: 16px;
            padding: 16px;
            margintop: 12px;
            animation: slideIn 0.3s easeout;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            boxshadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
        }

        .researchwidgetinteractive:hover {
            bordercolor: var(accentpink);
            boxshadow: 0 8px 30px var(accentglow);
            transform: translateY(2px);
        }

        .researchheader {
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            gap: 12px;
            marginbottom: 10px;
        }

        .researchspinner {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border: 3px solid var(border);
            bordertopcolor: var(accentpink);
            borderradius: 50%;
            animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        .researchtitle {
            fontsize: 14px;
            fontweight: 700;
            color: var(textprimary);
        }

        .livestatuscontainer {
            position: relative;
            height: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            fontsize: 12px;
            color: var(textsecondary);
        }

        .livestatusitem {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
        }

        .livestatusitem.current {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .livestatusitem.previous {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(100%);
        }

        .livestatusitem.next {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(100%);
        }
        
        .researchbadge {
            display: inlineblock;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentlightpink) 100%);
            color: white;
            borderradius: 12px;
            fontsize: 11px;
            fontweight: 700;
            marginleft: 8px;
            boxshadow: 0 2px 8px var(accentglow);
            texttransform: uppercase;
            letterspacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .modaloverlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.2);
            backdropfilter: blur(15px);
            webkitbackdropfilter: blur(15px);
            zindex: 1000;
            display: flex;
            alignitems: center;
            justifycontent: center;
            opacity: 0;
            pointerevents: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .modaloverlay.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            pointerevents: all;
        }

        .modalcontent {
            background: var(bgsecondary);
            border: 2px solid var(accentgold);
            borderradius: 20px;
            width: 90%;
            maxwidth: 800px;
            maxheight: 80vh;
            overflowy: auto;
            padding: 28px;
            transform: scale(0.95);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            boxshadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.3);
        }

        .modaloverlay.visible .modalcontent {
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .modalheader {
            display: flex;
            justifycontent: spacebetween;
            alignitems: center;
            marginbottom: 24px;
        }

        .modaltitle {
            fontsize: 20px;
            fontweight: 800;
            fontfamily: 'Playfair Display', serif;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);
            webkitbackgroundclip: text;
            webkittextfillcolor: transparent;
            backgroundclip: text;
        }

        .modalclose {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            fontsize: 28px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .modalclose:hover {
            color: var(accentpink);
            transform: rotate(90deg);
        }

        .analysissection h4 {
            fontsize: 14px;
            texttransform: uppercase;
            color: var(accentpink);
            marginbottom: 12px;
            letterspacing: 1px;
            fontweight: 700;
        }

        .analysissection pre {
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.5) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 100%);
            padding: 14px;
            borderradius: 10px;
            fontsize: 13px;
            lineheight: 1.6;
            color: var(textsecondary);
            whitespace: prewrap;
            wordwrap: breakword;
            maxheight: 250px;
            overflowy: auto;
            marginbottom: 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
        }

        @media (maxwidth: 1024px) {
            .sidebar {
                display: none;
            }
            .maincontent {
                padding: 16px;
            }
        }

        @media (maxwidth: 640px) {
            .logo {
                fontsize: 56px;
            }
            .tagline {
                fontsize: 22px;
            }
            .subtitle {
                fontsize: 15px;
            }
            .maincontent {
                padding: 12px;
            }
            .chatarea,
            .sidebar {
                borderradius: 12px;
            }
        }

        .statusindicator {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, var(accentpink) 0%, var(accentgold) 100%);
            borderradius: 50%;
            display: inlineblock;
            marginright: 8px;
            animation: pulsedot 2s infinite;
            boxshadow: 0 0 10px var(accentglow);
        }

        @keyframes pulsedot {
            0%, 100% {
                opacity: 1;
                boxshadow: 0 0 10px var(accentglow);
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.6;
                boxshadow: 0 0 20px var(accentglow);
            }
        }

        .reportsection {
            margintop: 16px;
            padding: 22px;
            background: lineargradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 240, 245, 0.95) 100%);
            borderradius: 16px;
            border: 2px solid var(border);
        }

        .reportsection h1,
        .reportsection h2,
        .reportsection h3 {
            margintop: 1em;
            marginbottom: 0.5em;
            color: var(accentpink);
            fontweight: 700;
        }

        .reportsection h1 {
            fontsize: 22px;
        }

        .reportsection h2 {
            fontsize: 19px;
        }

        .reportsection h3 {
            fontsize: 17px;
        }

        .reportsection strong {
            color: var(textprimary);
            fontweight: 700;
        }

        .reportsection sup {
            color: var(accentpink);
            fontweight: 700;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="hero" id="hero">
        <canvas id="herobackground"></canvas>
        <div class="herocontent">
            <div class="logo">Jade</div>
            <div class="tagline">Intelligencia Határokon Túl</div>
            <div class="subtitle">
                Használd ki a kollaboratív AI erejét hogy több ezer forrásból kutass, elemezz és szintetizálj információkat. 
                Jade nem csak keres—gondolkodik, értékel és felfedez. Akár órákig kutathat autonomikusan és 2030 oldalas jelentést készít.
            </div>
            <button class="ctabutton" onclick="startApp()">Kutatás Indítása</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="appcontainer" id="app">
        <div class="appheader">
            <div class="applogo">Jade</div>
            <div class="modetoggle">
                <button class="modebtn active" datamode="chat">Chat</button>
                <button class="modebtn" datamode="research">Kutatás</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="maincontent">
            <div class="chatarea">
                <div class="messages" id="messages"></div>
                <div class="inputarea">
                    <div class="inputwrapper">
                        <textarea 
                            class="messageinput" 
                            id="messageInput" 
                            placeholder="Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást..."
                            rows="1"
                        ></textarea>
                        <button class="sendbtn" id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">
                             <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" strokewidth="2.5" strokelinecap="round" strokelinejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="5"></line><polyline points="5 12 12 5 19 12"></polyline></svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sidebar">
                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Státusz</h3>
                    <div class="statcard">
                        <div class="statvalue" id="sourceCount">0</div>
                        <div class="statlabel">Elemzett Forrás</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Friss Források</h3>
                    <div id="sourcesList"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebarsection">
                    <h3>Rendszer</h3>
                    <div class="statcard">
                        <div style="display: flex; alignitems: center; fontsize: 14px;">
                            <span class="statusindicator"></span>
                            <span>Minden Rendszer Működik</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="analysismodal" class="modaloverlay">
        <div class="modalcontent">
            <div class="modalheader">
                <h3 class="modaltitle">AI Gondolatmenet</h3>
                <button class="modalclose" onclick="hideAnalysisModal()">×</button>
            </div>
            <div class="analysissection">
                <h4>Stratégia</h4>
                <pre id="analysisstrategy"></pre>
            </div>
            <div class="analysissection">
                <h4>Elemzés</h4>
                <pre id="analysisreasoning"></pre>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('herobackground');
        if(canvas) {
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let width, height, particles = [];
            const particleConfig = {
                count: 120,
                speed: 0.08,
                radius: 1.5,
                colors: ['rgba(255, 20, 147, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 133, 193, 0.8)', 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)']
            };

            const resize = () => {
                width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            };

            const createParticles = () => {
                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < particleConfig.count; i++) {
                    particles.push({
                        x: Math.random()  width,
                        y: Math.random()  height,
                        vx: (Math.random()  0.5)  particleConfig.speed,
                        vy: (Math.random()  0.5)  particleConfig.speed,
                        color: particleConfig.colors[Math.floor(Math.random()  particleConfig.colors.length)]
                    });
                }
            };

            const animate = () => {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    if (p.x < 0 || p.x > width) p.vx = 1;
                    if (p.y < 0 || p.y > height) p.vy = 1;
                    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                    ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, particleConfig.radius, 0, Math.PI  2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                });
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            };

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                createParticles();
            });

            resize();
            createParticles();
            animate();
        }

        let currentMode = 'chat';
        let isProcessing = false;
        let currentAnalysis = null;

        function startApp() {
            document.getElementById('hero').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'flex';
            addMessage('assistant', 'Üdvözlöm a Jadeben! Segíthetek gyors kérdésekben vagy mélyreható kutatást végezhetek több ezer forrásból. Akár órákig kutathatok és részletes jelentést készítek. Miben segíthetek?');
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.modebtn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.querySelectorAll('.modebtn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                btn.classList.add('active');
                currentMode = btn.dataset.mode;
                document.getElementById('messageInput').placeholder = currentMode === 'research' 
                    ? 'Írja be a kutatási kérdést mélyreható elemzéshez...'
                    : 'Kérdezz bármit vagy indíts mély kutatást...';
            });
        });

        const messageInput = document.getElementById('messageInput');
        messageInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            messageInput.style.height = 'auto';
            messageInput.style.height = ${Math.min(messageInput.scrollHeight, 90)}px;
        });

        messageInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendMessage();
            }
        });

        function addMessage(role, content, meta = {}) {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
            messageDiv.className = message ${role};
            const metaHtml = meta.type ? <div class="message-meta"><span class="research-badge">${meta.type}</span></div> : '';
            const formattedContent = meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' ? formatReport(content) : formatContent(content);
            messageDiv.innerHTML = ${metaHtml}<div class="message-content ${meta.type === 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' ? 'report-section' : ''}">${formattedContent}</div>;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function formatContent(text) {
            return text.replace(/\\(.?)\\/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\(.?)\/g, '<em>$1</em>').replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }

        function formatReport(text) {
            return text.replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h1>$1</h1>').replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>').replace(/^ (.?)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>').replace(/\\(.?)\\/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\(.?)\/g, '<em>$1</em>').replace(/$$(\d+)$$/g, '<sup>[$1]</sup>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        }
        
        function showLoading() {
            if (document.getElementById('loading')) return;
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const loadingDiv = document.createElement('div');
            loadingDiv.className = 'message assistant';
            loadingDiv.id = 'loading';
            loadingDiv.innerHTML = <div class="message-content"><div class="loading"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(loadingDiv);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }

        function removeLoading() {
            const loading = document.getElementById('loading');
            if(loading) loading.remove();
        }

        function showResearchWidget(analysis) {
            currentAnalysis = analysis;
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const widgetWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            widgetWrapper.className = 'message assistant';
            widgetWrapper.id = 'researchwidgetwrapper';
            
            widgetWrapper.innerHTML = 
                <div class="researchwidgetinteractive" onclick="showAnalysisModal()">
                    <div class="researchheader">
                        <div class="researchspinner"></div>
                        <div class="researchtitle">Kutatás folyamatban...</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="livestatuscontainer" id="livestatuscontainer">
                        <span class="livestatusitem current">Stratégia kidolgozása...</span>
                    </div>
                </div>;
            messagesDiv.appendChild(widgetWrapper);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function updateLiveResearchStatus(text) {
            const container = document.getElementById('livestatuscontainer');
            if (!container) return;

            const oldStatus = container.querySelector('.current');
            if(oldStatus) {
                oldStatus.classList.remove('current');
                oldStatus.classList.add('previous');
                setTimeout(() => oldStatus.remove(), 500);
            }
            
            const newStatus = document.createElement('span');
            newStatus.className = 'livestatusitem next';
            newStatus.textContent = text;
            container.appendChild(newStatus);

            setTimeout(() => {
                newStatus.classList.remove('next');
                newStatus.classList.add('current');
            }, 10);
        }

        function showAnalysisModal() {
            if (!currentAnalysis) return;
            document.getElementById('analysisstrategy').textContent = currentAnalysis.strategy;
            document.getElementById('analysisreasoning').textContent = currentAnalysis.reasoning;
            document.getElementById('analysismodal').classList.add('visible');
        }

        function hideAnalysisModal() {
            document.getElementById('analysismodal').classList.remove('visible');
        }

        function removeResearchWidget() {
            const widget = document.getElementById('researchwidgetwrapper');
            if(widget) widget.remove();
        }

        function updateSources(sources, count) {
            document.getElementById('sourceCount').textContent = count || 0;
            const sourcesList = document.getElementById('sourcesList');
            sourcesList.innerHTML = '';
            if (sources) {
                sources.slice(0, 5).forEach(source => {
                    const sourceDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    sourceDiv.className = 'sourceitem';
                    let hostname = 'N/A';
                    try {
                        hostname = new URL(source.url).hostname;
                    } catch (_) {}
                    sourceDiv.innerHTML = <div class="sourcetitle">${source.title || 'Cím nélküli'}</div>
                        <a href="${source.url}" target="_blank" class="sourceurl">${hostname}</a>;
                    sourcesList.appendChild(sourceDiv);
                });
            }
        }
        
        async function handleResearch(query) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/research', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'ContentType': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ query })
                });
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText});
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data.error) throw new Error(data.error);
                
                showResearchWidget(data.analysis);

                if(data.research_log) {
                    for (const log of data.research_log) {
                        const detail = log.includes(':') ? log.split(': ').slice(1).join(': ') : log;
                        updateLiveResearchStatus(detail);
                        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); 
                    }
                }
                
                updateLiveResearchStatus('Szintézis és jelentés generálás...');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    removeResearchWidget();
                    addMessage('assistant', data.answer, { type: 'AUTONÓM KUTATÁS' });
                    updateSources(data.sources, data.sources_count);
                }, 1500);

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Research error:', error);
                removeResearchWidget();
                addMessage('assistant', Hiba történt a kutatás során: ${error.message});
            }
        }

        async function handleChat(query) {
            showLoading();
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'ContentType': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ query })
                });
                
                removeLoading();
                if (!response.body) throw new Error("No response body");
                
                const reader = response.body.getReader();
                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
                let fullResponse = '';
                const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
                messageDiv.className = 'message assistant';
                messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="messagecontent"></div>';
                document.getElementById('messages').appendChild(messageDiv);
                const contentDiv = messageDiv.querySelector('.messagecontent');

                while (true) {
                    const { done, value } = await reader.read();
                    if (done) break;
                    const chunk = decoder.decode(value, {stream: true});
                    
                    const lines = chunk.split('\n\n');
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
                            const dataString = line.substring(6).trim();
                            if (dataString === '[DONE]') break;
                            if(dataString) {
                                try {
                                    const parsed = JSON.parse(dataString);
                                    if (parsed.content) {
                                        fullResponse += parsed.content;
                                        contentDiv.innerHTML = formatContent(fullResponse);
                                        messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
                                    } else if (parsed.error) {
                                        throw new Error(parsed.error);
                                    }
                                } catch (e) {}
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Chat error:', error);
                removeLoading();
                addMessage('assistant', Hiba történt a csevegés során: ${error.message});
            }
        }

        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('messageInput');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            if (!message || isProcessing) return;
            
            addMessage('user', message);
            input.value = '';
            input.style.height = 'auto';
            isProcessing = true;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
            
            if (currentMode === 'research') {
                await handleResearch(message);
            } else {
                await handleChat(message);
            }
            
            isProcessing = false;
            document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
        }

        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            navigator.serviceWorker.register('data:text/javascript,');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
